title: Executive Operations Director
description:
Executive Operations Director

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Reporting To: Sarai Bareman

Description

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the biggest female sporting event in the world, the pinnacle of women’s football globally and the main showcase for our sport, our athletes, our Member Associations, and our fans.

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027").

THE POSITION

The Executive Operations Director, under the guidance of the Executive Tournament Director and in close collaboration with the Head of the FIFA Women’s World Cup is responsible for the successful operational delivery of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 and all related events in accordance with the comprehensive project plan. This includes ensuring the appropriate hosting conditions are provided in collaboration with the host cities, stadium and venue owners, local authorities and third-party entities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Leadership & Team Management:
    • Lead and manage the operations team, working closely with all key stakeholders (FIFA Zurich, state and federal government where necessary, host cities, commercial partners, etc.).
    • Ensure effective collaboration between all departments and individuals involved in the tournament's operations.
    • Provide strategic guidance and decision-making during the tournament planning and execution phases.
    • Specifically, the Executive Operations Director shall be responsible for the key operational departments within FIFA27 Brazil, including: Venue Operations, Competitions & Team Services, Safety, security, accreditation & access control, Technology, Events & Entertainment, Medical, Technical Services / Infrastructure, Broadcast and media, Event Services (such as transportation, logistics, travel and accommodation).
  • Operational Planning & Execution:
    • Oversee the operational execution of the FIFA Women’s World Cup, covering all tournament venues, from logistics and planning through to match-day operations.
    • Implement and oversee operational plans, ensuring alignment with FIFA’s goals, budgets, and timelines.
    • Coordinate various functional areas to ensure seamless operations at all venues.
    • Manage the operational budget, ensuring resources are allocated efficiently across all functional areas.
    • Report on financial performance and provide operational cost optimization strategies.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Extensive Experience in Major Sports Events:
    • At least 8-10 years of experience in managing operations for large-scale sports events (e.g. World Cup, Olympic Games, continental championships, etc.).
    • Proven track record of managing cross-functional teams for international sporting events, with an emphasis on logistics, venue management, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Leadership & Management:
    • Strong experience in leading large teams, with the ability to manage diverse and high-performing teams.
    • Previous experience in a senior management role with decision-making authority.
    • Ability to work in high-pressure environments and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Operational Expertise:
    • In-depth knowledge of operational best practices in international sports events, including logistics, security, transportation, and venue operations.
    • Experience managing logistics for major international sporting events, including team operations, transport, logistics, goods delivery.
  • Knowledge of Sports Governance and Regulations:
    • Strong understanding of FIFA regulations, tournament operations, and the international sports governance landscape.
    • Knowledge of the compliance and safety standards required for international events.
  • Crisis Management & Problem Solving:
    • Strong crisis management skills with a proven ability to handle unforeseen challenges during large-scale events.
    • Ability to think quickly and implement solutions under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Management:
    • Proven ability to manage substantial operational budgets and resources.
    • Experience in cost control, optimizing event operations within budget constraints.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Relations:
    • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to liaise with high-level stakeholders, including government officials, commercial partners and media (when necessary).
    • Experience in managing relationships with diverse international stakeholders, including sponsors, local authorities, and FIFA officials.
  • Cultural Competency & Multinational Experience:
    • Experience working in multinational environments and understanding cultural nuances when coordinating across countries.
    • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian) with proficiency in additional languages (e.g., Spanish, French) preferred.

Visão geral

Você está pronto para alçar voo em um setor de aviação dinâmico e de ritmo acelerado? Nossa missão é simples: "Fornecer ao setor de aviação soluções consistentes e personalizadas em todo o mundo, para uma melhor experiência do cliente". Acreditamos que nosso pessoal é o que nos diferencia da concorrência. Na Swissport, somos guiados por nossos valores fundamentais de mostrar que se importa, Fazer as coisas certas e Vencer como uma equipe, e atualmente estamos buscando pessoas dedicadas, que se alinham com esses valores, para se juntar à nossa equipe em vários locais em todo o mundo.

Resumo do trabalho

Efetuar controle do carregamento e descarregamento de bagagens e cargas, prestando suporte às necessidades das aeronaves em terra.

Suas atividades

  • Garantir a precisão de controle de carga, cumprindo práticas e procedimentos de modo que o resultado tenha alto padrão no que diz respeito à segurança e qualidade;

  • Compreender e seguir leis aplicáveis, SOPs e políticas da Swissport;
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas, conforme solicitado.

Seu perfil

  • Comunicação

  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob condições de clima adversas
  • Flexibilidade de trabalho em diferentes turnos

O que oferecemos

  • VR / VA / VT / Assistência médica / Assistência Odontológica / Seguro de vida

Na Swissport, acreditamos na diversidade, na igualdade de oportunidades e no poder de nossos valores para impulsionar nosso sucesso. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um local de trabalho que promova a inclusão e onde todos os candidatos qualificados sejam considerados para emprego, independentemente de raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou status de veterano.

title: Gerente Tributário
description:
EY Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.

Em FSO, estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando organizações a prosperar em uma era de mudanças rápidas. Oferecemos serviços em todas as disciplinas tributárias e combinamos nosso conhecimento e experiência com as pessoas e as melhores plataformas de tecnologia; e isso nos torna um parceiro ideal para as necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais relacionadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios, entre outros.

#TAXFSO

Oportunidade disponível para atuação híbrida no escritório de São Paulo.

hybrid

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como uma pessoa Gerente de Tributos você será parte da área de Tax com foco na indústria financeira, atuando em consultoria tributária, auxiliando as empresas em projetos de compliance e consultoria em impostos diretos (CSLL e IRPJ) para bancos e seguradoras, assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Liderar equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos e exposições;
  • Realizar a revisão e preparação do imposto diferido e respectivas projeções de acordo com as normas ASC 740 e IAS 12, bem como Tax Provision e reconciliação da alíquota efetiva;
  • Realizar a revisão e preparação da apuração do imposto de renda e contribuição social seguindo as normas e legislações aplicáveis;
  • Realizar pesquisas e responder as consultas tributárias de clientes;
  • Atuar na revisão e preparação da ECF (Escrituração Contábil Fiscal) e ECD (Escrituração Contábil Digital);
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos de trabalho produtivos com os funcionários de clientes e avaliar sua satisfação;
  • Supervisionar o trabalho de campo diário, informar aos supervisores a situação do trabalho e gerenciar o desempenho da equipe;
  • Desenvolver as pessoas, por meio da delegação efetiva de tarefas e fornecimento de orientação à equipe, fornecendo feedback e treinamento com relação ao desempenho;
  • Contribuir com ideias/opiniões para as equipes de impostos e ouvir/ser receptivo/a ao ponto de vista de outros membros da equipe;
  • Ter um entendimento das linhas de serviço da EY e buscar/incentivar, de forma ativa, as pessoas da equipe a contribuírem com ideias e identificar oportunidades de aplicação dos serviços da empresa.

Por que você?

Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:

  • Graduação em contabilidade, direito, administração ou economia;
  • Experiência consistente em projetos que envolvam apuração de impostos diretos, desenvolvendo estratégias de planejamento tributário alinhadas às necessidades globais de cada cliente;
  • Profundo conhecimento em impostos diretos (IRPJ e CSLL – lucro real e lucro presumido) e na preparação e revisão de ECF e ECD;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Habilidade avançada na comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Habilidade no trabalho em equipe e liderança.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência em projetos de suporte a auditoria, compliance e planejamento Tributário;
  • Conhecimento em Digital TAX.

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias, por isso nossas vagas são destinadas para todas as pessoas. Oferecemos o suporte necessário, provendo acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiência, aplicação de metodologia de trabalho assistido para pessoas com deficiência intelectual e neurodiversas, assim como incentivamos a divulgação de vagas afirmativas como o Programa de Trainees exclusivo para PcD. A EY também conta com o grupo de afinidade Abilities+ que promove ações internas para a construção de um ambiente mais inclusivo.

Segundo o Great Place to Work 2023, somos a melhor empresa para Pessoas Pretas e Mulheres do Brasil e, a 2a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+. Além disso, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

Quer se sentir desafiado/a, motivado/a e valorizado/a todos os dias? Inspirar mudanças e deixar um legado? Faça parte do nosso time e ajude-nos na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor!

description:
Join to apply for the Access Center Nurse Coordinator role at Inside Higher Ed

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Position Summary

Under the direction of the Sr. Director of Clinical Development, Department Chair, or assigned Director, the Nurse Coordinator is a vital clinical leader responsible for supporting high-quality patient care through a combination of direct clinical services (Resource Time ) and care coordination, communication, and planning activities (Coordination Time ). This role ensures safe, efficient, and patient-centered care while improving communication between patients, clinical staff, and providers. The Nurse Coordinator can be assigned to two of the following departments; Surgery, Medicine, Pediatrics, Orthopedics, Ophthalmology, Neurology, Psychiatry, Family Medicine, Dermatology, Women’s Health, FPP Administration or the Access Center.

Key Responsibilities

Resource Time – Clinical Care & Education

Time allocated for direct patient-facing care and in-clinic clinical responsibilities, including:

  • Attend and make recommendations for departmental huddles and delegation of clinical duties
  • Perform clinical skills, medication administration, and other direct care duties
  • Support daily clinic operations, triage, and patient flow
  • Educate patients and families on health conditions, medications, and follow-up instructions
  • Participate in and deliver in-service training and continuing education to staff
  • Ensure accurate documentation of all clinical activities in the EHR
  • Monitor for quality concerns during clinical care and escalate as needed
  • Support referral management, by triaging referrals against Schedule Advisor protocols
  • Support authorization team, by responding to peer-to-peer requests
  • Provide pre-surgery and pre-procedure patient education
  • Route patients to follow up appointments post discharge
  • Work with the Access Center Nursing team to implement red/yellow/green triage matrix

Coordination Time – Planning, Collaboration & Administrative Support

Time dedicated to activities that support quality and continuity of care, including:

  • Participate in interdisciplinary team meetings and provider collaboration sessions with Providers
  • Review labs, imaging, and patient messages/tasks to support timely follow-up
  • Coordinate patient care across departments during afternoon staffing huddle
  • Support tracking and follow-up of patients with chronic conditions, missed appointments, or abnormal results
  • Engage in quality improvement activities like QSI rounds, chart reviews, and safety checks
  • Maintain accurate records for compliance with clinical guidelines and regulatory requirements
  • Assist with patient outreach to support adherence to treatment plans or follow-up appointments
  • Manage prescription refills

Minimum Qualifications

  • Registered RN – Required
  • DC License – Required or within 90 days if active current state license
  • BSN, MSN or MHSA, MPH or equivalent – Preferred
  • Certified in clinical specialty – Preferred
  • 2+ years experience in an academic health system - Preferred
  • 3+ years ambulatory nursing experience or 2 years inpatient experience on a med/surg unit - Required

Core Competencies

  • Patient-centered care and cultural sensitivity
  • Clinical judgment and escalation awareness
  • Effective communication with multidisciplinary teams
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced setting
  • Attention to detail and commitment to clinical excellence

Work Environment

  • Ambulatory clinical setting with a balance of patient-facing and administrative duties
  • May require sitting, standing, and moving between care areas throughout the day
  • Requires indirect supervision of non-licensed staff and/or medical assistants

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Pay Range: $95,000 to $100,000

Seniority level

  • Mid-Senior level

Employment type

  • Full-time

Job function

  • Health Care Provider

Industries

title: Billing Analyst I
description:
About Us

Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally. We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally. We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people. We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.

It is a hybrid schedule (3 days at the office per week) in Rio de Janeiro - Cinelândia.

Role Description

The Billing Analyst will have responsibility for specific client accounts in Airswift's sales ledger covering the North American region. You will join a strong team based in our Rio de Janeiro office and will be tasked with ensuring fully compliant and timely billing for clients under your remit.

Principle Accountabilities

  • Assure billing for the assigned client portfolio.
  • Adhere to client billing requirements as per contracts and work orders, call off orders, purchase orders, etc.
  • Liaise closely with consultants on new clients and new client billing requirements.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of billing, including recharges to clients.
  • Ensure timely delivery of invoices to clients along with a variety of supporting documentation.
  • Ensure reporting to the Supervisor of any un-invoiced, missed, or incorrect amounts that are not billed timely or become aged.
  • Ensure timely response to clients (external and internal) and report to the direct Supervisor of specific customer requests for timely delivery.
  • Report on funded invoices to the billing supervisor accurately and in a timely fashion.
  • Deliver pro forma invoicing, pre-approvals, SES, etc.
  • Ensure all banking information is correct on invoices as per funded or non-funded category, currency, and billing entity.
  • Follow up on invoices emailed to clients or via consultants to confirm receipt.
  • Reconcile client VMS with an internal invoicing system to ensure invoices are correctly submitted.
  • Monitor the status of invoices that were previously sent by email, portal, or VMS systems for any rejections that require correction.
  • Ensure intercompany invoices are issued correctly and in a timely manner between Airswift's legal entities.
  • Work to month-end deadlines.
  • Compare invoices from Tempest (payroll and billing system) to invoices generated in Amalto to ensure all relevant information has been saved in SharePoint and maintained in line with auditing requirements.
  • Import invoices to Dynamics 365 (financial ERP system), and balance payroll and billing Tempest to D365, ensuring all billing has been captured.
  • Complete submittal logs in a timely fashion and attend weekly submittal meetings with the Billing Supervisor.
  • Ensure all invoices and backups are filed in a shared drive and maintained.
  • Complete queries in a 48-hour turnaround (outside of main invoicing schedules) and maintain and complete query log.
  • Liaise with payroll to validate any payroll adjustments affected by credit notes and complete credit note logs for auditing purposes.
  • Review new client contracts with the Billing Supervisor to ensure all requirements are captured.
  • Ensure Bullhorn (client management system) data is correct and highlight errors to consultants and service teams accordingly.
  • Meet accuracy targets in line with KPIS.
  • Purchase order and work order analysis.
  • Maintain and deliver 3rd party reconciliations and advise the billing supervisor of details to pay – this is working with credit control to ascertain paid invoices (pay when paid basis).
  • Communicate with various parties of the PO analysis ceilings to ensure timely delivery of either renewed PO value or extended PO.
  • Support function for MIDE region invoicing as and when required.
  • Be fully involved in working with credit control to reduce DSO and improve the liquidity of Airswift for the North American region.
  • Follow company policies and procedures, guidelines, and standards.
  • Ad hoc duties as and when required.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Fluent English.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • 1+ years of experience in a finance function (billing experience preferred, but not required).
  • Knowledge of multi-currency transactions.
  • Knowledge of VAT and WHT is beneficial.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Good communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a challenging environment with the ability to meet deadlines and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Experience in liaising with various internal departments.
  • Focused and dedicated mindset.
  • Good team player with the ability to drive changes and improvements.
  • Knowledge of funding and non-funding.
  • Knowledge of withholding tax (training provided).

What we can offer you!

  • Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally!
  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work-life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)
  • Charity days for various important causes such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.

Our Core Values

  • Growth - In life and business, one must grow to flourish and achieve high ambitions. Growth requires change, challenge, risk and sacrifice - we will always choose growth.
  • Life – Above all else, we value life. The quality of life, both in and outside of work, profoundly influences our well-being and our impact on the world.
  • Excellence - We deliver, holding ourselves accountable for results. Our customers see excellence in everything we do.
  • Integrity - We are ethical, open, honest and authentic. People trust us to do the right thing for the right reason.

Visit our website and social media to find out more. Our website: Airswift is

Disclaimer

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Airswift, we believe that diversity is critical to our success and makes us a great place to work. We are committed to building an equal opportunity workplace, the more inclusive we are - the better our work will be.

title: Product Designer Sênior
description:
Overview

Afya Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
Somos aliados do médico durante toda a sua jornada e buscamos por pessoas que se identifiquem com nosso propósito, valores e cultura para se juntarem ao nosso time. Vamos juntos transformar a saúde com quem tem a medicina como vocação! Esta é uma vaga aberta na frente de Soluções para a Prática Médica, para trabalhar de forma híbrida na cidade de Rio de Janeiro/São Paulo e Belo Horizonte. Ao assumir o cargo de Product Designer Sênior na Afya, seu objetivo principal será garantir a experiência do usuário nos produtos, visando relacionar tanto os aspectos de usabilidade nas entregas, quanto aspectos de estratégia visando construir uma solução pautada sempre em feedbacks de usuários e em dados relevantes. Você atuará na área de Product Designer dentro da diretoria de Produto e fará parte de uma equipe multidisciplinar, relacionando-se no dia a dia com pessoas de times como Produto, tecnologia e dados. Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS.

Responsabilidades

  • Planejar e conduzir descobertas a fim de identificar e mapear oportunidades e dores relevantes dos nossos usuários e clientes, por meio de pesquisas e entrevistas com usuários;
  • Propor e participar da experimentação de hipóteses e conceitos, validando-os por meio de pesquisa com usuários, testes A/B, multivariáveis, split tests ou outros métodos de validação, a fim de ajudar na estratégia do produto;
  • Colaborar na definição de indicadores de sucesso e acompanhá-los por meio de follow ups recorrentes, para apoiar as decisões e direcionamentos do negócio;
  • Usar dados no desenvolvimento do projeto para formular hipóteses e sustentar decisões de Design;
  • Facilitar workshops e atividades de concepção junto ao time para guiar o desenvolvimento do produto, a fim de ter uma troca multidiscliplinar;
  • Executar e acompanhar processos de pesquisa com usuários, utilizando seus insights na construção e otimização do produto;
  • Construir e iterar experiências que estejam conectadas com objetivos de negócio e necessidades dos nossos usuários para alavancar a estratégia do produto;
  • Definir novos fluxos; criar interfaces usando nosso design system; criar protótipos de baixa, média e alta fidelidade quando preciso; realizando o handoff e acompanhamento da sua implementação

Requisitos e qualificações

O QUE BUSCAMOS (mas não esperamos que uma única pessoa atenda a todos os requisitos):

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Portfólio que mostre impacto real no negócio e na experiência do usuário, incluindo cases de estratégia, simplificação de jornadas e evolução de produto.
  • Experiência sólida em UI Design, com cases que envolvam design systems, mockups, protótipos e microinterações.
  • Vivência em manutenção e escala de design systems, com habilidade para propor, evoluir e escalar componentes.
  • Domínio de princípios e heurísticas de design, boas práticas de UX/UI e proficiência no Figma.
  • Experiência em product discovery e no desenvolvimento de produtos digitais em ambientes web e mobile.
  • Excelente comunicação, com capacidade de influenciar stakeholders e facilitar decisões de produto a partir de argumentos claros e bem estruturados.
  • Conhecimento de métricas de produto e KPIs, sabendo como usá-los para orientar decisões de design.
  • Mentalidade curiosa para explorar e experimentar ferramentas e tecnologias de IA.
  • Interesse em se manter atualizado(a) sobre tendências em IA e aplicá-las nos desafios de design.

Informações adicionais

GENTE É O MELHOR DA GENTE, por isso, oferecemos benefícios e parcerias para o nosso time. Confira os principais abaixo:

Para o dia a dia:

  • Vale-alimentação / refeição;
  • Flexibilidade de horários e alocações (para vagas Remotas);
  • Vale-transporte (para vagas Híbridas ou Presenciais);

UP na remuneração:

  • PLR;
  • Multibenefícios: Benefício flexível via Cartão Flash para usar como preferir.

Família, Saúde e Bem-estar:

  • Gympass / Wellhub;
  • Psicologia Viva (plataforma online para consulta com psicólogo e nutricionista);
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Licença parental estendida (até 6 meses para mães e 20 dias para pais);
  • Rede D\'Ór: suporte e informações importantes para a saúde da mamãe e do bebê com uma rede credenciada de enfermeiros;
  • Parceria com o SESC da sua região (programação variada nas áreas de educação, saúde, cultura, lazer e assistência);
  • Day Off de Aniversário (um dia de folga para tirar no dia ou durante o mês do seu aniversário).

Desenvolvimento e Aprendizado:

  • Plataforma com diversos cursos para aprimorar seu conhecimento (UCA);
  • Academia de idiomas (AIA);
  • Programa de desenvolvimento para líderes;
  • Mentoria para Mulheres da Afya (MMA);
  • Desconto em cursos de graduação e pós-graduação nas unidades de ensino da Afya.

Diferencial para Professor Médico:

  • Assinatura premium do Afya iClinic e Afya Whitebook

title: Service Delivery Coordinator
description:
Do you enjoy being part of a successful team?

Do you enjoy being part of a successful completion and wellbore intervention team?

Join our team!
We are the leader in well construction and production. Our innovative physical and digital solutions improve production and increase reservoir value. Our Completions Team partners with on-site operators and customers to provide support and guidance to ensure the capacity and value of the well is maximized to its full potential.

Partner with the best
The Service Delivery Coordinator ensures that Baker Hughes maximizes its short and long term revenue, profit and cash collection opportunity by ensuring flawless Service Delivery execution, on time delivery, contract adherence and cash collection for the assigned jobs. This position will coordinate the required job activities across organizational boundaries to ensure the company execute the job in line with customer and company expectations and contract terms and conditions.

As a Service Delivery Coordinator , you will be responsible for:

  • Protecting the health and safety of our personnel and the environment
  • Conduct all activities in line with our core values, and non-negotiables, applicable processes, and cultural pillars
  • Ensuring the assigned contracts/quotes are fully understood and capitalized upon
  • Primary resource for the Service Delivery Manager to assist in executing all activities as outlined in the Manage the Job Cycle process
  • Coordinating and monitor all job activities as outlined in the Manage the Job Cycle process across organizational boundaries
  • Accountable for the use of Job Center in location to manage the jobs at hand.
  • Accountable for Technical Review of the job planning, Equipment preparation and people readiness.
  • Responsible for scheduling and dispatching of resources in line with job requirements
  • Responsible for ensuring completion of training and development of Field population
  • Primary contact for client for job planning, preparation, execution and close out, and as such, will manage the relationship to ensure business success for the company
  • Be familiar with the assigned client’s process for MOC (management of change) / escalation to ensure the proper process is followed when there is risk of not achieving the clients objectives
  • Prompt escalation of issues that can impact service delivery
  • Ensuring invoice is in line with contract/quote, with no revenue leakage and timely collection of cash
  • Coordinating with field crews to manage any requirements / mobilizations during the job at the customer well site/location
  • Assisting other Service Delivery Coordinators with Technical Peer Reviews.


Fuel your passion
To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have a Bachelor’ Degree in an Engineering or other technical degree with proven experience
  • Have relevant work experience.
  • Have excellent communication skills and be fluent in English (verbal and written)
  • Proven leadership capabilities
  • Good interpersonal skills
  • Work from client office up to 50% of the time


Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit in everything in and work when you are the most productive
  • Working from client office – be flexible to be present on client office once needed or during the operation.

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  • Tailored financial programs
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits

About Us

With operations in over 120 countries, we provide better solutions for our customers and richer opportunities for our people. As a leading partner to the energy industry, we're committed to achieving net-zero carbon emissions by 2050 and we're always looking for the right people to help us get there. People who are as passionate as we are about making energy safer, cleaner and more efficient.

Join Us

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company with a global reach and exciting services and clients? Come join us and grow with a team of people who will energize and inspire you!

description:
Job description

Aqui, você teráalta autonomia para criar e executar estratégias de CRM , participando ativamente de decisões estratégicas e influenciando os rumos da empresa. Além disso, vai contar com espaço para desenvolver sua carreira, colocando em prática conhecimentos de dados, tecnologia e marketing em projetos complexos e desafiadores.

Estamos em busca de alguém que una visão analítica e estratégica, com experiência emconversão, retenção e personalização de jornadas multicanais . Um perfil que não apenas execute, mas tambémpense o negócio junto com a liderança e traga soluções inovadoras para alavancar crescimento.

Se você se identifica com esse perfil e quer crescer em um espaço que valoriza protagonismo, vem fazer parte do nosso time!

Main responsibilities

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Criar estratégias de CRM para conversão, retenção e personalização da jornada do cliente.
  • Planejar e executar campanhas multicanais (e-mail, SMS, WhatsApp, push) conectadas ao funil de originação.
  • Definir KPIs estratégicos de CRM, monitorar resultados, implementar boas práticas e recomendar ações de negócio.
  • Modelar e analisar bases de dados complexas usando conhecimento avançado de SQL para manipulação de dados e construção de segmentações.
  • Estruturar estratégia de otimização de performance de jornadas através de testes A/B robustos e análise estatística.
  • Desenhar e implementar jornadas automatizadas e segmentadas , além de réguas que suportem escalabilidade.
  • Aplicar inteligência artificial e automações para personalização em escala e predição de comportamento.
  • Elaborar relatórios semanais/mensais de gestão, apresentando insights à diretoria.
  • Conduzir integrações sistêmicas (APIs, data lakes, ferramentas de CRM) .

Requirements and skills

Experiência

  • Experiência em CRM, Growth ou Marketing de Relacionamento, com histórico em estratégias de conversão e retenção .
  • Ter realizado iniciativas de CRM para produtos digitais complexos e multimarcas , aplicando alavancas proprietárias de crescimento .
  • Participado e implementado jornadas automatizadas de conversão e retenção, com impacto direto em KPIs de receita.
  • Conhecimento de planejamento e análise de bases de dados usando SQL, com foco em segmentação inteligente e personalização em escala.
  • Experiência consolidada em gestão de testes A/B multicanais , incluindo definição de hipóteses, acompanhamento e implementação de grupos de controle universais .
  • Responsável por acompanhamento de KPIs estratégicos para funil de originação e relacionamento.

The Venue Technology Manager is responsible for supporting the Technology team with venue specific technology related deliverables for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails coordinating with all relevant parties the planning, implementation, readiness and operations of all Event Technology services pertinent to the tournament and / or associated events within Brazil.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible to ensure all aspects of Technology, Telecommunications and Broadcast Technology Services are implemented in accordance with the pre-agreed FIFA Technology requirements at the assigned venue(s).
  • Manage a strong diverse Venue Technology team composed of paid staff, contractors and volunteers for operating the technology services at the assigned venue(s).
  • Collaborate with stakeholders’ groups, clients, providers, and government entities in relation to ensuring the delivery of technology services across all venues, in accordance with the defined governance structure.
  • Manage and contribute to the venue technology working groups in accordance with the agreed governance structure across all aspects of the tournament programme (planning, implementation, readiness and operations).
  • Manage the technology demand / needs requirements for technology services across the tournament space (Technology Equipment Allocation Process).
  • Plan the delivery of suitable end user technology equipment and services to all FWWC 2027 departments and FIFA constituent groups, including hardware, services and consumables.
  • Facilitate the collection and distribution of technology requirements of all client groups involved in the FWWC 2027 across all client groups, including, Media, Broadcast, Guest Operations, Commercial, Football Technology etc.
  • Ensure that all information pertaining to infrastructure, services and spaces needed for the delivery and support of all technology services are communicated to, and understood by, venue/site authorities and respective delivery teams.
  • Provide guidance and direction to relevant teams on matters relating to the structural build-out and technology services implementation, including the commissioning and final decommissioning of all tournament venues.
  • In collaboration with assigned personnel and Stadium partners, relevant parties (private and governmental) enable / support the timely delivery of venue technology services.
  • Develop regular progress, risk and issue management reports in accordance with the governance structure / reporting methodologies and, or PMO systems
  • Manage the on-site IT Technicians and support teams during tournament time operations, including end-of-day reporting and incident escalation to IT Command Centre.

  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex IT programs and projects

  • Consistently interacts professionally and works productively with all levels of employee.

  • Good Leadership skills and able to manage and motivate other team members
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Ability to adapt speech to audience coming from a broad spectrum of disciplines and with various levels of technical knowledge
  • Leadership and accountability across all areas of relevance
  • Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments

Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

Diferenciais

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, com UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, com 39 leitos, para absorver demandas de menor complexidade, liberando o HMPII para casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. title: Product Delivery Planner
description:
Overview

Do you enjoy being part of team that provides high-quality project delivery for our customers?

Are you passionate about meticulous planning and attention to detail?

Join a team that delivers essential projects

We devise smarter systems to control and monitor oil and gas extraction. Innovating in the energy industry, our subsea and surface pressure capabilities are industry leading. Our team is responsible for the successful development, deployment, and delivery of our cutting-edge, world class control systems.

Responsibilities

As Product Delivery Planner you will be in-charge of planning a large subsea project. The planner will be accountable for the schedule quality and project on-time delivery. The position reports to the Project Delivery Planning Manager.

As a Product Delivery Planner, you will be responsible for:

  • Scheduling Management: The planner is in-charge of the overall project schedule management, ensuring its quality (logic, clarity) and accuracy (update of dates, reflection of the scope of supply).
  • Coordinating: The planner will be collaborating with the other planners (product line planner & engineering planners) allocated to the project and with the execution functions (engineering, procurement, and manufacturing) to ensure the overall quality and accuracy of the schedule.
  • Supporting Project management: The planner is the right-hand of the project manager and, as such, will provide visibility on: i) Looking ahead of tasks to be performed in the 3 – 6 weeks; ii) Risks in schedules and mitigation actions; iii) Opportunities in the schedule.
  • Providing relevant reports to project management to ensure the project manager has all the tools to make the right decisions and drive on-time and on-budget project execution.
  • Interacting with the customer to provide schedule updates and explain the current situation, challenges, and opportunities.
  • Adhering to the approved processes and proactively drive the implementation of new initiatives that will lead to fully integrated planning.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have a Bachelor / Master’s degree or equivalent (Engineering / Math/ Science degree is ).
  • Have expressive experience working within planning, ideally in the oil and gas/subsea industry or a related large-scale mechanical manufacturing or controls equipment environment.
  • Be an expert in the use of the Primavera P6 planning tool.
  • Have additional knowledge of Oracle MRP is considered a plus.
  • Have ability to understand the status of a project and link the schedule to the reality of the execution.
  • Have ability to quickly understand the risks and opportunities in the schedule and identify and drive appropriate actions.
  • Have strong expertise in planning a large project and using the Primavera P6 planning tool.
  • Have high energy and motivation to deliver against and beyond expectations, making a difference in the position.
  • Have strong leadership and excellent interpersonal skills are required to collaborate with a team of planners and interact with a large panel of individuals who will contribute to the project's performance.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  • Tailored financial programs
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits

About Us

We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

Join Us

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.

  • Conferências, seminários e workshops : Além das aulas, o intérprete também pode ser solicitado a atuar em eventos acadêmicos, como conferências, seminários, discussões de grupos de pesquisa, ou apresentações de pôsteres e trabalhos de estudantes.
  • Discussões em grupo e rodas de conversa : Quando alunos surdos participam de discussões em grupo ou interações em seminários, o intérprete facilita a comunicação entre os colegas ouvintes e o estudante surdo.
  • Atividades culturais e sociais : O intérprete também pode ser necessário em eventos culturais ou sociais organizados pela universidade, como festas, exposições ou eventos de integração, para garantir a participação do aluno surdo.
  • Atividades esportivas e recreativas : Caso a universidade ofereça atividades esportivas ou recreativas inclusivas, o intérprete pode ser fundamental para garantir que o estudante surdo se sinta parte do grupo.
  • Reuniões com orientadores ou tutores : O intérprete facilita a comunicação entre o aluno surdo e os professores ou orientadores, especialmente durante reuniões de orientação de trabalhos de conclusão de curso (TCC), dissertações, estágios e outras atividades acadêmicas.
  • Reuniões de grupos de estudo : Caso o aluno surdo participe de grupos de estudo, o intérprete pode atuar para garantir que ele tenha acesso a todas as informações e discussões do grupo.

Buscamos um profissional com:

  • Curso superior ou técnico em áreas relacionadas à tradução e interpretação de Libras : O intérprete de Libras deve possuir formação específica na área. Existem cursos técnicos ou de graduação em Libras , Tradução e Interpretação de Libras/Português , que são fundamentais para garantir que o profissional tenha o conhecimento teórico e prático necessário.

title: Manager, Overlay Cluster
description:
Manager, Overlay Cluster

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Overlay Cluster Manager plays a key role in the planning, coordination, and delivery of temporary infrastructure across a group of assigned venues. This position requires close collaboration with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas (FAs), stadium authorities, and various stakeholders to ensure that overlay solutions are functional, cost-effective, and fully aligned with operational needs and technical standards.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and other stakeholders to define, optimize and validate overlay solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.
  • Implement change management processes and maintain budget control for venues under your responsibility. Organize, coordinate, and oversee the flow of technical information (e.g., drawings, requirements, updates) across all venues in the cluster.
  • Maintain clear communication with stadium authorities to ensure alignment on timelines, by monitoring construction schedules, planned renovations, and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Work closely with overlay delivery partners from planning through construction and removal, monitoring the execution of the project scope to ensure all requirements are met and that spaces are handed over on time and to the expected quality throughout all project phases, including reinstatement.
  • Provide regular updates on overlay progress at assigned venues, track project milestones and deliverables, and support timely resolution of issues or delays.
  • Support operational design development by transforming raw data into accurate base CAD drawings, integrating operational, overlay, and legacy content, and ensuring all updates adhere to FIFA standards and templates. Delivering complete and timely drawing sets aligned with project schedules and inspection requirements.
  • Align and establish a clear and consistent code/naming convention for commodities to be integrated into the design, enabling effective status tracking and change management control.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 years or more in infrastructural projects or Overlay/Technical Service roles in Major Events for a Sporting Organization.
  • Strong technical knowledge in temporary infrastructure.
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Autodesk applications (AutoCAD, Revit, BIM 360, Autodesk Construction Cloud, etc.)
  • Proficient in MS Office 365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project)
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Availability to travel as needed

description:
Job description

Buscamos um(a) Especialista de Inteligência B2B altamente analítico(a), estratégico(a) e com sólida experiência nos setores de combustíveis, energia ou commodities, para integrar a nossa área de Pricing em uma das maiores distribuidoras do Brasil.

Este(a) profissional será responsável por desenvolver, analisar e otimizar políticas e estratégias de precificação para o mercado B2B, com foco em maximizar a rentabilidade, fortalecer a competitividade e gerar valor sustentável para o negócio. Atuará de forma transversal com áreas como Comercial, Financeira e de Inteligência de Mercado, contribuindo diretamente para decisões estratégicas e posicionamento comercial da companhia.

Main responsibilities

  • Atuar na formulação e manutenção da política de preços para diferentes segmentos de clientes B2B, considerando aspectos tributários, logísticos, concorrenciais e de margem;
  • Desenvolver e aplicar modelos analíticos e algoritmos de precificação dinâmica, utilizando ferramentas como Python, Power BI, Tableau, entre outras;
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de performance (KPIs) relacionados à rentabilidade, margem por cliente, elasticidade de preço, volume e participação de mercado;
  • Apoiar o time comercial com simulações de preços, análises de cenários e projeções de impacto financeiro, contribuindo para a tomada de decisão estratégica;

  • Construir e apresentar relatórios gerenciais e dashboards executivos, com análises críticas e recomendações estratégicas para as lideranças;
  • Interagir com áreas como Comercial, Supply, Tributário, Logística, Finanças e Tecnologia da Informação, atuando como elo entre a estratégia e a execução;
  • Conduzir projetos de melhoria contínua, automação de processos e implantação de ferramentas de pricing.

Requirements and skills

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Estatística, Ciências Atuariais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação, MBA ou Mestrado será considerado diferencial;
  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em áreas de Pricing, Inteligência de Mercado, Planejamento Comercial ou Estratégia;
  • Sólida vivência em empresas de energia, óleo e gás, distribuição de combustíveis, bens industriais ou commodities;
  • Experiência com precificação B2B em ambientes complexos e de alta competitividade;
  • Domínio de ferramentas analíticas e de visualização de dados: Excel avançado, Tableau, Power BI;
  • Desejável: conhecimentos em Python, R ou ferramentas de Machine Learning aplicadas a pricing;
  • Forte entendimento de formação de preços, margens, estrutura de custos, tributos (ICMS, PIS/COFINS, substituição tributária) e dinâmica de mercado;
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado será considerado diferencial.

title: Senior Enterprise Architect - Tietoevry Care (m/f/d)
description:
Overview

At Tietoevry Care you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.

About us

Tietoevry Care is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care.

We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from healthcare to social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

About the role

We are looking for a strategic and visionary Enterprise Architect who can define, lead, and align our technology strategy across the entire healthcare platform ecosystem. In this role, you will

  • Set the architectural direction for our platform products
  • Oversee alignment across different products
  • Ensure long-term scalability, interoperability, and maintainability
  • Support international expansion into the wider European healthcare market

You will engage directly with

  • Customers to explore new clinical and operational workflows, and digital transformation needs
  • Partners to co-develop, integrate, and ensure compatibility within a modular platform ecosystem
  • Product Management and Product Owners to align architectural vision with product strategies and roadmaps

As an Enterprise Architect, you will

  • Define and evolve the enterprise-wide architecture for our healthcare platform products
  • Align architecture across product teams, domains, and business stakeholders
  • Drive adherence to healthcare standards such as openEHR, FHIR, and HL7
  • Lead strategic architectural initiatives such as modularization, capability-based planning, and platform evolution
  • Govern architecture principles and ensure compliance across all layers (business, application, data, and infrastructure)
  • Act as a key advisor to business and product leadership regarding technology roadmaps and transformation programs
  • Guide solution and software architects and foster collaboration across multidisciplinary teams
  • Contribute to technology partner strategies, vendor evaluations, and interoperability initiatives

We are looking for someone with:

  • Broad experience in enterprise architecture across complex product ecosystems
  • Deep understanding of architecture principles / frameworks
  • Proven ability to align business and technology strategies
  • Familiarity with open digital health platforms and healthcare-specific standards (openEHR, FHIR)
  • Experience designing scalable and modular architecture in cloud-native and containerized environments
  • Leadership experience in driving change and enterprise-wide architecture governance
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including international and partner collaboration

As a person you are:

  • Strategic in your thinking and system-minded
  • Collaborative and able to work across different teams, organizations and cultures
  • Committed to excellence and long-term impact
  • Curious, open-minded, and adaptable

What’s in it for you?

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work-life balance. description:
Job Description

The Overlay Cluster Manager plays a key role in the planning, coordination, and delivery of temporary infrastructure across a group of assigned venues. This position requires close collaboration with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas (FAs), stadium authorities, and various stakeholders to ensure that overlay solutions are functional, cost-effective, and fully aligned with operational needs and technical standards.

  1. Collaborate with the Venue Design team, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and other stakeholders to define, optimize and validate overlay solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.
  2. Implement change management processes and maintain budget control for venues under your responsibility. Organize, coordinate, and oversee the flow of technical information (e.g., drawings, requirements, updates) across all venues in the cluster.
  3. Maintain clear communication with stadium authorities to ensure alignment on timelines, by monitoring construction schedules, planned renovations, and infrastructure upgrades.
  4. Work closely with overlay delivery partners from planning through construction and removal, monitoring the execution of the project scope to ensure all requirements are met and that spaces are handed over on time and to the expected quality throughout all project phases, including reinstatement.
  5. Provide regular updates on overlay progress at assigned venues, track project milestones and deliverables, and support timely resolution of issues or delays.
  6. Support operational design development by transforming raw data into accurate base CAD drawings, integrating operational, overlay, and legacy content, and ensuring all updates adhere to FIFA standards and templates. Delivering complete and timely drawing sets aligned with project schedules and inspection requirements.
  7. Align and establish a clear and consistent code/naming convention for commodities to be integrated into the design, enabling effective status tracking and change management control.

Your profile

  • Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 years or more in infrastructural projects or Overlay/Technical Service roles in Major Events for a Sporting Organization.
  • Strong technical knowledge in temporary infrastructure.
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Autodesk applications (AutoCAD, Revit, BIM 360, Autodesk Construction Cloud, etc.)
  • Proficient in MS Office 365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project)
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro
  • Availability to travel as needed

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Quantitative Analyst
description:
Overview

We are the Latin American branch of Match Group, the world's largest company for dating websites and apps. Our brands include Match.com, Tinder, OkCupid, Par Perfeito, Divino Amor, Our Time, Hinge, Stir, and more. Our mission is to create meaningful connections for every person everywhere. We are passionate about love and focused on building and integrating technology to help connect people.

The Match Group brands worldwide include Par Perfeito (a pioneering brand in Brazil and the largest in online serious relationships), Hinge (an inclusive dating app for real people seeking real-life relationships), POF (a dating site for casual or serious relationships), Match.com (the world's largest dating site), and Tinder (the leading global app to meet new people). Match Growth & Revenue is looking for a Quantitative Analyst to join their newly formed Data Science pod. This role applies insights to identify wins across our portfolio (including Match, OKCupid, and PlentyOfFish), drives business impact through analysis of test results and ecosystem trends, collaborates with Product and Development teams, and conducts quantitative research on how users find love. We work IRL in our Dallas office two days per week.

We believe that the connection starts online, but the real magic happens IRL — and so do our best works.

Responsibilities

  • Liaise with individual brands to understand their business models, track ecosystem trends, and identify opportunities across the portfolio
  • Conceive and conduct quantitative research to better understand user behavior and inform future initiatives
  • Collaborate with Product and Development teams to shepherd projects from ideation to delivery
  • Propose and design tests for discounting, merchandising, and pricing, with a focus on cross-brand applicability
  • Monitor AB tests, identify opportunities for segmentation and iteration, and model long-term ecosystem and revenue impacts
  • Improve consistency and efficiency of internal querying, reporting, and dashboarding processes

Qualifications

  • You have 3+ years of experience in a role related to business analytics or product analytics
  • You are proficient in SQL (MSSQL and/or Redshift preferred)
  • You are proficient in Microsoft Office and/or Google Drive apps, especially Excel/Sheets
  • You are proficient in statistical software such as R or Python
  • You have a solid understanding of statistics and modelling techniques
  • You have the ability to work collaboratively on a diverse team
  • You have a Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent knowledge) or higher in business, economics, mathematics, quantitative social sciences, statistics, or related field

Why work with us?

Our mission is to help people find love and happiness and we take great care of our employees.

At Match Group LatAm, you will have:

  • Autonomy to develop in a light, fun, and technologically innovative environment
  • Flexibility for work and hours
  • Competitive salary package and bonuses, according to company policy
  • Competitive meal voucher/meal allowance
  • Health and dental plan, extendable to spouse and dependents (not included for interns)
  • Gympass to support health
  • Home Office Assistance: monthly allowance for home office expenses
  • Incentive to participate in events
  • Udemy for Business: access to over 183,000 online courses on-demand
  • In-Company English: English training with 80% company contribution and 20% employee contribution
  • Annual Check-up for employees aged 40+
  • "Baby Bonding Leave" — 12 weeks of fully paid paternity leave for new parents
  • International Career Opportunities: opportunities to work abroad within Match Group with local autonomy and global support

We hope you feel excited to join our team, with autonomy to bring your ideas to life without bureaucracy or rigid hierarchies. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the hiring process, please indicate this to your recruiter.

Job description for Offshore Planner position

Reports To: Offshore Maintenance Superintendent (hierarchically)
Onshore Planning Lead (functionally)


Background: This position will be responsible for the look ahead and ensuring that all planned and corrective maintenance is effectively scheduled to meet requirements considering the activities in the asset plan and associated vendor requirements. They are the owner of 14 and 28 days look ahead.
Accountable For: Typical Responsibilities & Standards

1) Develop And Maintain Effective Working Relationships
Establish and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues and visitors to the working environment.
Establish and maintain effective communications with colleagues, external visitors and supervisors.
Carry out accurate and effective work handovers.
2) Implementation of Management System
Ensure compliance with applicable IOP planning and CMMS procedure.
Liaise, prepare and update Unit weekly planning and scheduling activities.
Conduct weekly Planning meetings with offshore HOD’s and onshore IOP planner to freeze 14 days look ahead schedule.
Ensure any conflict in respect to SIMOPS, resources and materials are highlighted to the relevant parties.
Ensure in conjunction with all HOD’s that all assurance activities are carried out on the schedule and comply with unit’s verification scheme.
Responsible for reviewing & prioritizing all corrective work requests with the work team to ensure corrective work order priorities are properly assigned.
3) Control of Works
Offshore owner of 14 and 28 days plan lookahead, ensuring that all planned and corrective maintenance is effectively scheduled to meet requirements considering the activities in the asset plan and associated vendor requirements.
Monitor weekly execution progress
When required develop work plans for maintenance jobs with necessary information to allow efficient scheduling, assignment, and execution of maintenance work.
Perform site readiness check and validate the appropriate job work scope with the offshore disciplines and feedback to onshore unit planner.
Monitor Maintenance KPIs and performances, warn support team of any recurring problems related to the maintenance activity back log.
Suggests improvements and requests modifications for planning and for the CMMS and Work Order flow chart.
4) Management of Conditions, Behaviours and Events
Contribute to the continued improvement and implementation of the best practices in the planning discipline.
Review CMMS reporting are done efficiently and correctly. Equally, help with CMMS activities such as correction of Notifications, upload activities report under CMMS, and so on.

Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience
Degree in relevant technical or business discipline or can be substituted by suitable industry experience.
Extensive experience as a maintenance planner or Supervisor in oil and gas upstream industries.
A basic knowledge of the process of oil and gas treatment, installations and a thorough knowledge of the equipment used in oil and gas treatment installations.
Experience in Planning software (primavera P6) and CMMS (IFS) and electronic Permit-to-Work systems.
Proficiency in English at a minimum of B1 level according to the CEFR international standard.

title: Interpretation Geophysicist
description:
Join to apply for the Interpretation Geophysicist role at Viridien .

Viridien ( is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

Job Summary

We are looking for passionate geoscientists to join our Interpretation Team at Viridien. In this role, you will contribute directly to Velocity Model Building (VMB) by performing seismic interpretation and providing essential geological support to Processing and VMB teams. From picking horizons to building velocity scenarios, you will work at the intersection of geology, geophysics, and advanced imaging tools, helping to transform complex seismic data into meaningful insights. Your work will play a critical role in delivering high-quality results to our clients and shaping decisions across energy and earth-data projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform seismic interpretation for VMB, including horizon picking (unconformities, salt horizons, pre-salt).
  • Create local velocity scenarios.
  • Apply imaging tools, workflows, and data QC (attributes, velocities, maps).
  • Integrate geological and geophysical data for deeper insights.
  • Engage directly with clients to present results and understand their perspectives.

About The Team

You will join a diverse group of interpreters, geologists, and geophysicists who collaborate closely with Processing and VMB teams. Together, we tackle complex challenges, share knowledge, and drive innovation in seismic imaging. At Viridien, collaboration is key — you will be encouraged to bring your ideas forward and grow in a supportive environment.

Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Geophysics, Geology, or related field; or equivalent professional experience in the Oil & Gas industry.
  • Solid background in seismic interpretation, exploration geology, stratigraphy, or basin analysis.
  • Strong geophysical knowledge (seismic attributes, AVO, reservoir characterization, quantitative interpretation, well data QC/processing).
  • Ability to integrate data across scales (well, seismic, potential data).
  • Good understanding of seismic imaging and prospect assessment.
  • Experience with Pre-Salt or Brazilian Equatorial Margin is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  • Effective communication and presentation skills in English.
  • Python programming is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Relocation package (when applicable).
  • Comprehensive health and dental insurance.
  • Private Pension Plan
  • Meal Voucher
  • Free breakfast and snacks at the office.
  • Shiatsu Therapy at the Office
  • TotalPass Fitness Program
  • Hybrid Work Model (up to 2 remote days per week)
  • Birthday Day Off
  • Christmas Gift Card
  • Educational Assistance and Language Learning Programs
  • Continuous training via the Learning Hub, with both technical and behavioral courses.

Our Hiring Process

At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience. We may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant due to high application volumes. Candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview, and we aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round and beyond. If you require any reasonable adjustments to participate in the application or interview stages, please contact your recruiter directly. We value diversity and are committed to equal employment opportunities for all professionals.

  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Psicólogo.

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

A Flowa Technologies é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada em mercado financeiro e pioneira no segmento de Electronic Trading. Desenvolvemos soluções tecnológicas robustas e eficientes voltadas para a negociação eletrônica de ativos financeiros nas principais bolsas das Américas. Atuando sob o conceito de “tecnologia como serviço”, atendemos as principais corretoras de valores, gestores de recursos e investidores institucionais do mercado. Temos o compromisso contínuo com o desenvolvimento de soluções inteligentes, ágeis e que transformem a experiência de investir, priorizando a estabilidade, velocidade e segurança para os nossos clientes. Movidos por tecnologia e inovação, sede de aprendizado contínuo e vontade de fazer a diferença, somos um time comprometido e apaixonado pelo que fazemos. Estamos atualmente envolvidos em um projeto único: a criação de uma nova bolsa de valores para o Brasil. Junto com a nossa evolução, crescem os desafios e buscamos profissionais com iniciativa, motivados e com disposição para aprender.

No seu dia a dia você irá :

  • Elaborar, revisar e negociar contratos complexos envolvendo instituições financeiras, investidores, intermediários e demais participantes do mercado;
  • Apoiar a estruturação de produtos, serviços e parcerias sob regulamentação do BACEN e da CVM;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva e preventiva, assegurando conformidade regulatória e mitigação de riscos;
  • Produzir pareceres jurídicos objetivos, claros e orientados ao negócio;
  • Prestar suporte em demandas societárias e regulatórias relacionadas à bolsa de valores;
  • Relacionar-se com stakeholders estratégicos, órgãos reguladores e escritórios externos.

O que você precisa

  • Inglês fluente (oral e escrito);
  • Experiência comprovada em contratos regulados por BACEN e/ou CVM;
  • Vivência em operações no mercado financeiro, preferencialmente em ambientes de bolsa, corretoras, bancos ou gestoras;
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara, negociação em alto nível e visão estratégica.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em contencioso civil, trabalhista e/ou tributário;
  • Histórico de atuação em ambientes regulados.

A Flowa é movimento, crescimento e evolução. Aqui você encontrará um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde todos são protagonistas. Se você busca uma oportunidade de crescimento e quer fazer parte de uma equipe engajada no propósito de transformar o mercado de electronic trading, vem com a gente!
