title: Project Accountant
description:
Overview

The Project Accountant is a finance professional responsible for managing the financial control of strategic projects, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely reporting. This role requires technical project accounting expertise and strong communication and collaboration skills to work with project teams, auditors, and international colleagues in a multicultural environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Financial Control & Compliance
    • Maintain financial control over project accounts and ensure compliance with company policies and contractual terms.
    • Support compliance with audit requirements and contractual obligations.
    • Identify project-related risks and recommend mitigation strategies.
    • Prepare monthly and quarterly financial reports, including cash flow statements and 17-week rolling forecasts.
    • Calculate and monitor Percentage of Completion (POC) for revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15.
    • Deliver accurate financial insights for decision-making, including variance analysis and project profitability.
    • Prepare and monitor hedge calculations, manage multi-currency exposures, and advise on hedging needs.
    • Ensure high-quality reporting standards with clear ownership of accuracy and completeness.
    • Work closely with project management, cost control, procurement, subcontracting, and planning teams to align financial data with operational activities.
    • Translate operational progress into accurate financial impacts, including engineering team mobilization, project management teams, and marine vessel schedules.
    • Interface with planners to ensure the timely and correct reflection of project milestones and costs.
    • Serve as a key interface with internal stakeholders, auditors, and client representatives.
    • Support the analysis of new bids and tenders, with particular focus on cash flow projections and financial feasibility.
    • Provide insights to management on the potential financial risks and returns of new projects.

Key Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years preferably in oil & gas, EPCI, or construction industries.
  • Education: Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or Engineering.
  • Advanced Excel and strong ERP system knowledge.
  • Solid understanding of POC revenue recognition, hedge accounting, and multi-currency project environments.
  • Languages: Advanced to fluent in English & Portuguese.
  • Strong communication skills to effectively liaise with multicultural, international teams.
  • Ability to work independently with ownership of deliverables and accountability for report quality.
  • Analytical, proactive, and solutions-oriented profile.

Cuidando de você, sempre!
Somos a Drogaria Venancio, uma marca carioca que, há mais de 45 anos, coloca o cuidado no centro de tudo o que faz. title: ENFERMEIRO GENERALISTA - CENTRO OBSTÉTRICO - MATERNIDADE MARIA AMÉLIA BUARQUE DE HOLLANDA
description:
Job description

O Hospital Maternidade Maria Amélia Buarque de Hollanda integra a Rede de Atenção materno-infantil e ginecológica no Município do Rio de Janeiro. Suas ações tem por objetivo garantir a integralidade na linha de cuidado, visando a ampliação e qualificação do acesso humanizado das gestantes à assistência hospitalar. Seus processos e fluxos assistências estão ancorados no acolhimento com classificação do risco e em Diretrizes Clínicas baseadas em evidências que viabilizam a resolutividade e a qualidade na atenção prestada.

Inaugurada em 2012 a Maternidade oferta atividades assistenciais nas 24 horas do dia, todos os dias da semana, inclusive sábados, domingos e feriados.

O Serviço possui papel estratégico na atenção perinatal em articulação com os demais serviços da Rede de Atenção à Saúde, articulada com a rede de atenção primária à saúde da AP 1.0 e regiões circunvizinhas.

Main responsibilities

  • Organizar a operacionalização do serviço de Enfermagem e garantir o bom andamento dos serviços; realizar orientações aos pacientes; manter controle de salas equipamentos e leitos disponíveis; orientar o trabalho da equipe de técnicos;
  • Atender as normativas do Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN);
  • Garantir o cumprimento das rotinas, normas e protocolos institucionais e de SMS;
  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem ao usuário, desde a sua admissão, e acompanhar o atendimento técnico;
  • Atuar como facilitador de todos os processos que envolvem o atendimento de enfermagem;
  • Promover, juntamente ao gestor, ambiente que proporcione melhorias contínuas no processo assistencial;
  • Manter a comunicação com o corpo clínico, referente a mudanças no fluxo da Assistência de Enfermagem (quando interferir em processo médico);
  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem segura, humanizada e individualizada aos pacientes;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de normas e recomendações estabelecidas junto aos serviços de saúde colaborando para o controle de infecção;
  • Ministrar treinamentos quando necessário promovendo atualização contínua à equipe de enfermagem;
  • Auxiliar o gestor no controle de certificação profissional da equipe de enfermagem junto ao conselho de classe, assim como executar o processo de comunicação junto órgão;
  • Conduzir a gestão das notificações de não conformidades de avaliação de eficácia, referentes à Assistência de Enfermagem;
  • Gerir o controle de entrada e saída de materiais estocados no setor, mantendo o estoque mínimo necessário para o desenvolvimento da Assistência de Enfermagem;
  • Preencher e supervisionar o preenchimento dos registros específicos da Assistência de Enfermagem;
  • Assegurar a correta utilização dos equipamentos e acessórios disponíveis para o processo assistencial;
  • Prestar assistência a pacientes graves, desde a admissão, e acompanhá-los em caso de remoção á outro serviço;
  • Organizar processo de armazenamento de receituários controlados;
  • Organizar e controlar processo de esterilização de materiais;
  • Supervisionar ou acompanhar a realização de procedimentos assistenciais, enfocando segurança e diminuição de riscos de infecção;

The Company You’ll Join

Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta also supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under administration. Carta's tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You work within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline. You will:

  • Liaise between Sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post-sales for new fund clients
  • Interact with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical accounting data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders
  • Book and reconcile all accounting books and records from, at times, unstructured client data. This includes reproducing Capital Calls, Distributions, Expenses, Investments, Management Fees, Financial Statements, and Partners’ Capital to match client sources.
  • Resolving escalations related to data migration, historical accounting discrepancies, and client onboarding issues
  • Manage all aspects of customer onboarding for medium to high complexity new clients by managing timelines, setting clear customer expectations, and completing all compliance procedures pre go-live
  • Build strong client relationships and provide a white glove experience by going on-site, anticipating client needs, and using Carta app capabilities effectively
  • Identify process and quality improvements, assist with internal reviews, Quality Assurance, and train junior team members
  • Sharing accounting and onboarding specificities with upstream teams for efficient post go-live fund administration

The Team You\u2019ll Work With

Our implementation accounting team acts as the bridge between sales and long term account management for new fund clients. The team ensures whatever information our clients had before joining Carta is correctly migrated into our system. Ours is a team of folks who have mastery of accounting, exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject-matter expertise to provide customers with a world-class onboarding experience.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in an accounting role where you executed all aspects of end of quarter and year closes, preferably working within the Venture Capital Fund Administration environment
  • Strong accounting analysis skills with the ability to interpret a story through multiple years of unstructured data, and reproduce Financial Statements correctly
  • Ability to build strong client relationships through transparent and forthright communication. Able to manage multiple clients while hitting deadlines and providing white-glove service
  • Passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously

Salary

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) range for this role is:

  • $102,000 - $120,000 in San Francisco, CA, Santa Clara, CA, and New York, NY
  • $96,900 - $114,000 in Seattle, WA

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the recruiter via email. As a company, we value fairness, helpfulness, transparency, leadership and build our teams around these values. Check out our careers page to get to know us better as you think about your next step at Carta.

Important Security Notice for Candidates

Our company has been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com domain. Be cautious of any requests for sensitive information or payments outside of our official channels. Companies and funds like Tribe and Pipe build their businesses on Carta. title: Técnico de Teste
description:
Overview

Você gosta de trabalhar com várias equipes para garantir a entrega no prazo?

Você gostaria da oportunidade de desenvolver sua carreira em uma empresa global de energia?

Junte-se a nossa equipe! Somos líderes em construção e produção de linhas flexíveis. Nossas soluções físicas e digitais inovadoras aumentam a eficiência, a produção e maximizam o valor do reservatório.

Faça parceria com os melhores:

O Técnico Teste será responsável pela avaliação do estado dos equipamentos de testes, organizando os equipamentos disponíveis para as atividades de montagem seja para testes de pequena, média e grande escala nos laboratórios da planta, como também, trabalhando em conjunto com o time de planejamento e engenharia de testes.

Como Técnico de Teste , você será responsável por:

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e aplicação de ferramentas para adequação da estrutura de testes existentes, dando suporte operacional nas áreas de hidráulica, elétrica, eletrotécnica e mecânica
  • Responsável pelas instalações de teste, bancadas de teste, sistemas de instrumentação e teste de comissionamento de testes e bancadas e, na operação e inspeção de vasos de pressão.
  • Atuar em atividades que exijam trabalho em altura, espaço confinado e no içamento de cargas quando aplicável.
  • Comprometimento com a qualidade das atividades desempenhadas com o levantamento de medições de produtividade e engajamento com as políticas de qualidade internas para alcançar o grau de qualidade exigida pelos nossos clientes
  • Execução de testes laboratoriais, montagem e instrumentação de vasos de pressão.
  • Realizar testes hidrostáticos em vasos de pressão e em sistemas hidráulicos;
  • Realizar a instrumentação dos vasos de pressão;
  • Dimensionamento e seleção de transdutores de pressão, válvulas de alívio de pressão, sensores de temperatura tipo PT-100.
  • Execução de instrumentação e instalações hidráulicas e pneumáticas (ex.: dobra de tubing e instalação de conexões 1/4’’ NPT, 1/4” OD, válvula esfera e agulha).
  • Trabalhar e assegurar a conformidade com as políticas e procedimentos da empresa relativos à Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente, assegurando que sejam praticados por seus colaboradores, reportando qualquer não-conformidade, acidente, incidente ou potenciais situações de risco e interrompendo eventuais situações inseguras ou prejudiciais ao meio ambiente, à saúde e à segurança, baseado em atitude, treinamento, liderança e comprometimento.

Alimente sua paixão

Para ter sucesso nesta função, você precisa:

  • Ensino Técnico de Nível Médio em Mecânica, eletrotécnica, elétrica, eletrônica ou Metalurgia completo
  • Registro ativo no conselho de classe (CRT) – mandatório
  • Inglês técnico básico desejável (leitura e interpretação de desenhos e normas técnicas)
  • Desejável experiência em materiais metálicos e poliméricos
  • Leitura e interpretação de desenhos, Metrologia e utilização de instrumentos de medição (mandatório)
  • Ter conhecimento do Pacote Office, Solidworks (desejável)
  • Conhecimento em Autocad (desejável)
  • Possuir conhecimento em montagem e dissecação de End Fitting, Duto Flexível e dispositivos de teste instalados em dutos flexíveis (mandatório)
  • Possuir habilidade em equipamentos mecânicos, montagem de controles e servomecanismos, instalações hidráulicas e pneumáticas de pequeno e grande porte bem como noções básicas de condução de testes da indústria de O&G, sobretudo de tubulações flexíveis (mandatório)
  • Ter disponibilidade para eventualmente trabalhar em turnos para atuar em intervenções ou processos críticos
  • Possuir experiência prévia em testes laboratoriais, montagem e instrumentação de vasos de pressão (mandatório)

Trabalhe de uma maneira que funcione para você

Reconhecemos que cada pessoa é diferente e que a maneira como as pessoas desejam trabalhar e oferecer o melhor é diferente para cada pessoa também. Nesta função, podemos oferecer os seguintes padrões de trabalho flexíveis:

Sabemos que somos melhores quando todos os nossos funcionários são desenvolvidos, engajados e capazes de trazer todo o seu ser autêntico para o trabalho. Investimos na saúde e no bem-estar de nossa força de trabalho, treinamos e recompensamos talentos e desenvolvemos líderes em todos os níveis para trazer à tona o melhor de cada um.

Nossas invenções revolucionaram a energia por mais de um século. Mas para seguir em frente amanhã, sabemos que temos que ultrapassar os limites hoje. Priorizamos recompensar aqueles que adotam a mudança com um pacote que reflete o quanto valorizamos suas contribuições. Junte-se a nós, e você pode esperar:

A posição de Especialista Tributário tem como objetivo liderar tecnicamente as estratégias de compliance e defesa tributária da empresa, com foco em tributos federais diretos (especialmente IRPJ e CSLL), atuando de forma proativa na gestão de riscos, na condução de processos de contencioso administrativo, interpretação e normatização de legislação federal e na identificação de oportunidades fiscais. Este profissional será referência técnica na área, com papel consultivo e estratégico junto às demais áreas da empresa e escritórios externos.

Responsabilidades do Cargo

  • Liderar tecnicamente a apuração e revisão dos tributos federais diretos (especialmente IRPJ e CSLL).

  • Monitorar e interpretar mudanças na legislação tributária federal, em especial a Reforma Tributária, propondo estratégias de adequação de processos internos e aproveitamento de oportunidades.
  • Ser membro ativo e protagonista dos impactos da Reforma Tributária do Consumo (e outras reformas) desde a interpretação da legislação até adequações sistêmicas.
  • Apoiar em planejamento tributário, projetos especiais e na estruturação de operações com impacto fiscal.
  • Participar de comitês internos e reuniões estratégicas com áreas como Jurídico, Contabilidade, Planejamento Financeiro e Negócios e correlatas.
  • Atuar como mentor técnico para analistas da área.

  • Inglês avançado (imprescindível para comunicação com matriz, relatórios e auditorias).

Overview

Demand Manager Brazil – Haleon

Lead the process of generation and market sign-off on the most reliable forecast for all products in the market or markets under responsibility, coordinating cross-functional inputs to drive decisions on volumes based on quality data analysis. Provide visibility to improve supply and financial planning processes to optimize inventory, avoid write-offs, and improve customer service. The role is a key stakeholder for the General Manager and Leadership Team in the market(s) represented.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the process of generating an unconstrained and constrained forecast on a monthly basis (core activity in the IBP process).
  • Enable monthly validation of business performance and support decisions to achieve commercial objectives integrated with finance by identifying, analyzing, and defining actions to cover risks or gaps against the Plan.
  • Manage end-to-end demand forecasting across all brands to improve forecast accuracy and enhance customer service levels in line with external benchmarks.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver sales gap closing opportunities as required.
  • Define key forecasting roles and accountabilities across the business to align Sales, Marketing, Trade and Finance and drive a one-number mindset for decision making and forecast transparency.
  • Act as unbiased and neutral Business Partner to the General Manager and LT.
  • Establish and embed revised Demand Forecasting processes to support the Supply Chain Operating Model and Core Commercial Cycle.
  • Establish processes to support key account and trade channel-specific forecast capability to drive service levels and reduce working capital requirements.
  • Manage Demand Forecasting input into key IBP meetings (Demand Review, Supply Review, regional S&OP).
  • Identify and understand forecast changes across short- and long-term horizons to support supply chain action and informed decision making.
  • Ensure seamless handover of demand forecast and market intelligence to supply planning hubs to optimize inventory levels.
  • Integrate Trade Spend/Net Sales inputs to prioritize cost-effective net sales delivery.
  • Lead or contribute to significant projects to transform the operating model, including gross-to-net, complexity reduction, COGs, and working capital improvements.
  • Develop technical and IT capabilities to support baseline statistical modeling and integration of forecast platforms for improved accuracy.
  • Deliver long-range volume forecasts for plan submission and mid-year review.
  • Internally measure and report demand forecasting KPIs to drive improvements in forecast accuracy, bias, working capital, and customer service.
  • Provide a consolidated view of forecast trends and robustness across all Trade Channels/Categories.
  • Lead Brand/Category and Channel forecast input into Demand Review Meetings; challenge Sales/Marketing inputs to align volume and value forecasts across business units.
  • Collaborate with Category & Shopper/Sales and Marketing teams to validate NPI forecasts and assumptions.
  • Recruit and develop talent to support best-in-class forecast capability and performance.
  • Incorporate Sample and Promotional Packs inputs as required; maintain detailed knowledge of all forecast components (statistical baseline, promotions, cannibalization, market intelligence, NPI).
  • Monitor key trends impacting market, sector, and category performance.
  • Support and ensure QMS-compliant processes are in place and followed; promote a safe and compliant working environment.

Why you?

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s in Industrial Engineering, Logistics, or similar
  • At least 3 years as a demand planner or related position
  • Experience managing direct reports

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in supply chain, logistics, demand management, or related fields
  • Proactive in leading and managing information and data from the supply chain
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Leadership and influencing abilities
  • Relationship-building capability
  • Strong customer service awareness
  • Strategic and lateral thinking to deliver large-scale solutions
  • Experience with SAP and Excel; highly developed analytical skills

title: Billing Analyst I
description:
Join to apply for the Billing Analyst I role at Airswift

Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally.

We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally! We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people.

We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.

It\'s a hybrid schedule (3 days at the office per week) in Rio de Janeiro - Cinelândia.

Role Description

The Billing Analyst will have responsibility for specific client accounts in Airswift\'s sales ledger covering the North American region. You will join a strong team based in our Rio de Janeiro office and will be tasked with ensuring fully compliant and timely billing for clients under your remit.

Principle Accountabilities:

  • Assure billing for the assigned client portfolio.
  • Adhere to client billing requirements as per contracts and work orders, call off orders, purchase orders, etc.
  • Liaise closely with consultants on new clients and new client billing requirements.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of billing, including recharges to clients.
  • Ensure timely delivery of invoices to clients along with a variety of supporting documentation.
  • Ensure reporting to the Supervisor of any un-invoiced, missed, or incorrect amount that is not billed timely manner to the client or becomes aged.
  • Ensure timely response to clients (external and internal) and report to the direct Supervisor of specific customer requests for timely delivery.
  • Report on funded invoices to the billing supervisor accurately and in a timely fashion.
  • Ensure all banking information is correct on invoices as per funded or non-funded category, currency, and billing entity.
  • Follow up on invoices emailed to clients or via consultants to confirm receipt.
  • Reconcile client VMS (vendor management system) with an internal invoicing system to ensure invoices are correctly submitted.
  • Monitor the status of invoices that were previously sent by email, portal, or VMS systems for any rejections that require correction.
  • Ensure intercompany invoices are issued correctly and timely manner between Airswift\'s legal entities.
  • Work to the month-end deadlines.
  • Compare invoices from Tempest (payroll and billing system) to invoices generated in Amalto to ensure all relevant information has been saved in SharePoint and maintained in line with auditing requirements.
  • Import invoices to Dynamics 365 (financial ERP system), and balance payroll and billing Tempest to D365, ensuring all billing has been captured.

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Coordinator, Team Services will support organizing internal operations and administrative matters within the Team Services department at the FIFA27 office in Rio de Janeiro.

The key requirements will be to establish and maintain efficient working relationships within the department and across other functional areas, proactive communication and the sharing of information, systematic work processes, diligent record keeping, and any other administrative support required by Team Services colleagues.

They will provide support in the areas of team operations and team facilities (training sites and team hotels), ensuring consistency in overall planning and administrative tasks.

  • Providing administrative support for Team Services across operational concepts, policies, procedures and documentation and data management;
  • Supporting interactions between functional areas for the delivery of services for all participating teams and referees through specific administrative functions (i.e. preparation of materials, agendas, reports, follow-ups and minutes, as needed);
  • Coordinating the overall recruitment, selection and training process for Team Liaison Officers for participating teams;
  • Leading the overall Team Services Volunteer project, including recruitment, management and training of volunteers in cooperation with the Volunteer Management department;
  • Supporting overall IT project development and data input/management (Rate card project, Team Hub App, Power BI, We Track) within Team Services and coordinating the delivery of all services to be provided to teams via these systems;
  • Supporting the preparation and delivery of readiness exercises and training materials for tournament staff and volunteers, as advised by the Senior Team Services Manager;
  • Contributing to the Team Base Camp brochure with provision of adequate information, updating the brochure platform on regular basis;
  • Supporting the preparation and implementation of readiness exercises (simulation exercises) at Team Base Camp Hotels at Team Base Camp Training Sites with all member associations involved;
  • Contribute to and support the preparation of maps and drawings for team and referee training sites and hotels (including security perimeters, parking allocation, media facilities, etc.);
  • Supporting the maintenance of other internal project management systems utilized before and during the tournament(s); and any other duties that may be assigned.

YOUR PROFILE

  • A minimum of two years of experience in team services (operations and team facilities) as well as in event/project management, ideally at the international level.
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, including both pre-event planning and event implementation.
  • Excellent communicator with strong planning, organizational and administrative skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to consistently deliver at a high standard.
  • Able to work closely and collaboratively with others, while being self-motivated and able to work independently.
  • Able to work with a team on the same projects and, as required, work independently to contribute to projects.
  • Capable of making decisions using problem-solving skills and exercising sound judgement to achieve results.
  • Comfortable and flexible when working in an international, demanding and changing environment.
  • Able to adapt to and work well with people from other cultures and/or with other backgrounds.
  • Able to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain experienced and less experienced employees.
  • Able to understand and adapt to new information quickly, and comfortable with learning new systems.
  • High energy levels, strong negotiation and facilitation skills, excellent communication and presentation skills and positive relationship management abilities.
  • Strong IT skills, including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams), Smartsheet and other planning tools.
  • Familiarity with Power BI, We Track is an asset
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Any additional language skills a strong asset (especially Spanish and French).
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Senior Instructional Designer
description:
We Offer

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Instructional Designer to lead the design, development, and delivery of innovative e-learning and blended learning solutions in Brazil. In this role, you will combine hands-on instructional design with leadership and project management responsibilities, guiding a team of designers, developers, and external partners while ensuring the delivery of high-quality learning experiences and adherence to our global development framework. Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English are essential.

This is a newly formed role and part of our expansion in Brazil. The successful candidate will bring an entrepreneurial mindset, helping to shape the function and drive local growth, while collaborating closely with our established global teams. You will benefit from clear frameworks and support but also have the opportunity to influence and innovate within our learning design approach.

This is a full-time position based in our training centre in Rio.

Key Responsibilities

Instructional Design

  • Analyse learning needs to scope and design engaging and effective e-learning solutions
  • Develop learning objectives, storyboards and assessments for both e-learning and blended learning products which are aligned with adult learning principles and comply with industry standards
  • Apply instructional design models and learning methodologies to create engaging e-learning experiences which align with Maersk Training’s standards, style guides, processes, procedures and templates.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and coach a team of instructional designers and e-learning developers.
  • Assign and oversee tasks, providing guidance and constructive feedback to ensure quality and consistency of products.
  • Foster a collaborative, innovative, and high-performance team culture.
  • Conduct performance reviews and support team members’ professional development.

Project Management

  • Manage multiple e-learning projects end-to-end, ensuring delivery on scope, quality, timeline, and budget.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, and resource allocation.
  • Work closely with the existing Digital Content Team and L&D Managers in the development of learning products.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for stakeholders, SMEs, and clients, ensuring clear communication and alignment of expectations.
  • Monitor project risks, dependencies, and quality assurance processes.
  • Drive continuous improvement in instructional design processes and project management practices.
  • The confidence to balance competing priorities, and maintain high standards in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

We are looking for

To succeed in the role, you will likely bring:

  • 7+ years of experience in instructional design/e-learning development, including 3–4 years in team leadership or project management.
  • Proven success managing cross-functional teams and complex e-learning projects.
  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and organisational skills.
  • Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English, with the ability to adapt learning and communication styles to ensure training is relevant and accessible to both local and international audiences .

Um Analista de Glosaé o profissional responsável por analisar, identificar e resolver divergências em faturas médicas ou de outros serviços prestados, com o objetivo de garantir a cobrança correta dos valores e evitar prejuízos financeiros para a empresa ou cliente. description:
Overview

The Principal Operations Engineer is responsible for interpreting internal or external business issues and recommending best practices. They will be tasked with solving complex Operations-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal Operations Engineer may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and are regarded as a specialist in the field of Operations. As such, they must have in-depth expertise in Operations as well as broad knowledge of the Operations discipline within the Fabrication function.

Qualifications

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in any relevant Engineering Discipline
  • 5 to 7 years of experience in the Offshore Industry
  • At least 2 years of supervisory experience
  • Working knowledge of design and offshore project execution

Responsibilities

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Review and approve installation procedures and engineering to ensure they meet the project and McDermott minimum requirements and follow good engineering practices and enable work to be performed safely
  • Supervise the Field Engineers in their planning and execution of the offshore project
  • Supervise the Field Engineers during the preparation of material lists for construction materials and liaise with the Project Coordinator for procurement of requirements in a timely manner
  • Resolve any technical problems that arise during offshore installation and assist in any corrective action that is required
  • Ensure there is coordination with the Fabrication/Loadout Contractor affecting operations under supervision
  • Liaise with the fabrication hook-up group on the projects that they are responsible for and provide them with the required marine support equipment and logistics assistance
  • Develop the scope of work, assist in the award of subcontracts, and then coordinate the same
  • Review invoices received from vendors and subcontractors for errors or omissions in work performed or materials supplied
  • Provide or coordinate input to the tender process as required
  • Ensure conformance to Level 2 procedures for all the project-specific wire rope applications and rigging
  • Manage the project fabrication inter/intra-function coordination throughout various phases with engineering, SCM, detail design, fabrication, and hook-up
  • Identify resource needs for the fabrication portion of the project and report the fabrication status of the project with minimal guidance
  • Lead and develop the project’s fabrication execution strategy
  • Understand the overall project scope of work to lead and guide the multi-discipline production engineering team to meet project fabrication deliverables in line with the fabrication sequence/schedule
  • Manages project fabrication progress within schedule, and productivity within targeted budget in coordination with the project Construction Manager and Project Construction Superintendent
  • Appraises functional and project management on project fabrication status including issues which is expected to impact the forecasted progress, productivity, and schedule commitments with possible mitigation plans
  • Lead the Fabrication Bid coordination efforts on assigned Bid projects including completing the deliverables to meet submission dates
  • Interface with key project personnel from various functions like Engineering, SCM, Quality, Cost control, Marine Operations, hook up etc. to meet priorities and schedule dates for project fabrication requirements
  • Ensure necessary documentation and compliance with procedural requirements throughout the project/Bid phases
  • Establish a productive working relationship with client and third-party representatives
  • Conduct Fabrication and Load out HAZID meeting with all project stakeholders and fab team
  • Conduct Fabrication readiness meetings with all the functional leads and ensure the continuity of fabrication
  • Manage any scope of work changes and ensure AFC estimates are getting updated in line with the scope changes

title: Senior Product Manager (Bangkok-based)
description:
Senior Product Manager (Bangkok-based) – Agoda

Join to apply for the Senior Product Manager (Bangkok-based) role at Agoda .

About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.

Our Purpose - Bridging the World Through Travel

We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding and happiness. We are a skillful, driven and diverse team from across the globe, united by a passion to make an impact. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

Your opportunity

This role is BANGKOK-BASED, RELOCATION PROVIDED. Our Senior Product Managers are analytical and data-driven individuals, responsible for building products end-to-end, focusing on analyzing and experimenting until our solutions are perfectly tailored to our travelers. You will drive product strategy and partner closely with senior leadership cross-functionally to define, build, and deliver the best travel solutions. You will get dedicated engineering resources that you, and only you, define and allocate. We expect you to have a hands-on mentality and spend considerable time with your SCRUM teams, have enthusiasm to develop engineered processes and technologies and apply innovative solutions to make organizational improvements. Product Managers can modify every system we have in our company to suit their needs.

By applying to this role, you'll be considered for a role either in User Experience, Marketing, Finance or Supply product vertical. The goal is to match you with the team that best aligns with your interests, competencies, and where you will have the most impact. We’re looking for Senior Product Managers for every part of our business. Our entire Product team sits in Bangkok. This is an Individual Contributor position.

You will get to:

  • Analyze the online travel ecosystem, markets, competitive landscape and user requirements
  • Conceptualize, launch and optimize products and features, experiment, test their performance and iterate quickly
  • Work collaboratively with Engineering, Marketing, Legal and UX teams on cutting-edge technologies
  • Develop innovative solutions to some of the world’s difficult problems by collaborating as needed across regions, product areas, and functions

What you'll need to succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, or similar quantitative discipline)
  • Proven ability to leverage analytics and quantitative methods to inform and influence decision-making
  • Strong data skills
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written in English) with proven ability to convey complex messages clearly to different stakeholders
  • Experience developing and launching products
  • Experience leading global product vision, go-to-market strategy and design discussions

Overview

Sales Representative, Senior role at American Bureau of Shipping (ABS) — The Senior Sales Representative drives sales performance for ABS’ maritime training offerings. The Sales professional should be comfortable with ambitious targets, managing customer and partner relationships, and coordinating with regional training centers to broker learning solutions that meet customer needs. The professional will be central in articulating the value of ABS’ innovative maritime training solutions, ensuring customer satisfaction, and leveraging industry insights to position and sell maritime client training.

What You Will Do

  • Communicate the value of ABS training offerings to external customers, B2B partners, and internal collaborators.
  • Work with ABS regional academy managers to provide sales support and understand customer needs.
  • Own and manage relationships with ABS training customers and serve as the primary point of contact for sales.
  • Coordinate pre-sales and pre-delivery calls with training customers, leveraging subject matter experts and instructors when necessary.
  • Actively prospect and generate leads for maritime training customers and conduct on-site client visits.
  • Periodically attend training deliveries to better understand customer profiles and cultivate relationships.
  • Collaborate with other business development personnel within ABS to bundle and cross-sell training offerings to a wide range of ABS customers.
  • Strategically expand the buying relationship by identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling.
  • Review evaluation feedback from training participants, monitor and ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Respond to RFPs with proposals that highlight ABS’ strengths in delivering cutting-edge educational technology and compliance training.
  • Collaborate with teams across marketing, product management, and service delivery to ensure cohesive client strategies and high satisfaction levels.
  • Utilizes existing software and services for handling Client Relationship Management (CRM).
  • Provide support to consulting, development, and other sales groups as requested.
  • Attend events, client committees, and industry conferences to represent ABS and its training offerings.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends, particularly in alternative energy sources and digitalization.

What You Will Need

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Sales, Business, Marketing, Maritime Studies, or a related field.
  • At least ten (10) years of robust sales experience preferred, within the international shipping industry, with a proven track record of managing and expanding client relationships.
  • Experience and proven ability to sell to training customers in a B2B, for-profit commercial training market.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills and strong organizational and project management abilities.
  • Willingness to travel to meet clients, attend industry events, and engage with stakeholders across various regions.
  • Understanding of the shipping industry’s operational and regulatory challenges.
  • Strong interpersonal and team skills, including functioning successfully in a cross-functional team.
  • Ability to gain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management System.

Reporting Relationships

The Senior Sales Representative reports to a senior member of management within the ABS Learning Organization and has no direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

A Prudential é uma empresa global de 150 anos de história com presença em mais de 50 países e estamos há mais de 27 anos ajudando a minimizar o impacto financeiro que um imprevisto pode representar na vida de milhares de famílias brasileiras. Somos a maior seguradora independente no segmento de vida e tivemos uma média de crescimento de 27% de faturamento no país nos últimos 10 anos. Com crescimento sólido, reputação global e líder de mercado, nos dedicamos a oferecer soluções inovadoras e personalizadas de seguros de vida individual e em grupo para nossos clientes.

MOVIDOS POR PROTEGER, INSPIRADOS POR PESSOAS

Aqui na Prudential, oferecemos soluções personalizadas de seguros de vida individual e em grupo para milhões de brasileiros. Nosso propósito e crescimento acelerado nos posicionaram como a maior seguradora independente no segmento de pessoas (excluindo VGBL). É com muito orgulho que alcançamos mais de 5 milhões de vidas protegidas no Brasil. Com 150 anos de atuação no mundo, a Prudential tem operações nos Estados Unidos, Ásia, Europa e América Latina.

A Prudential do Brasil é um lugar para realizar em meio a um time que valoriza a colaboração. Se nosso símbolo é o rochedo, a nossa força são nossas pessoas, suas histórias e seu repertório. Conheça um pouco mais sobre nós:

SOBRE A POSIÇÃO

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Suportar o sistema que atende à operação de Vida com foco em produtos de acumulação;
  • Traduzir as necessidades das diferentes áreas de negócio que utilizam o sistema em requisitos a serem explorados na plataforma de mercado adquirida pela companhia. Sempre com a ótica de maximizar os retornos versus os investimentos necessários;
  • Acompanhar as demandas que viraram necessidades de desenvolvimento do lado do fornecedor, para garantir a entrega no prazo e qualidade esperados;
  • Conduzir com os times internos de TI as validações funcionais e todos os fluxos necessários que permita a devida auditoria do processo de desenvolvimento e mudanças;
  • Liderar projetos e iniciativas estratégicas da área, para entrega de valor para as áreas de negócio;
  • Atender a questões regulatórias com tempestividade e de auditoria com a seriedade e prioridade que requerem;
  • Priorizar e acompanhar o tratamento de incidentes e problemas, fazendo os reportes executivos cabíveis em tempo adequado;
  • Manter comunicação eficaz com as áreas parceiras, incluindo áreas internas de TI e de negócio;
  • Usar análise de dados e métricas para tomada de decisão. Avaliação de desempenho dos produtos e identificação oportunidades de melhoria.

Do que você precisa:

  • Comunicação eficaz
  • Perfil analítico
  • Tenacidade
  • Senso de urgência
  • Comprometimento
  • Orientação ao cliente
  • Inconformismo
  • Experiência em Sustentação e Evolução de Sistemas, preferencialmente em empresas de seguro
  • Conhecimento sólido em métodos ágeis, Kanban e Lean
  • Habilidades de comunicação excepcionais
  • Experiência prévia com medição de valor, análise de esforço e condução de priorizações

Buscamos alguém que tenha experiência em...

  • Experiência prévia no segmento de seguros e/ou previdência
  • Inglês avançado/fluente

Aqui você tem flexibilidade com nosso modelo de trabalho híbrido (3x2) . Essa posição será baseada em Rio de Janeiro .

NA PRUDENTIAL, VOCÊ PODE CONTAR COM:

  • Assistência médica e odontológica
  • Vale refeição e vale alimentação
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo Prudential
  • Participação nos lucros
  • Previdência privada com 100% de complementaridade
  • Auxílio creche ou babá
  • Programa de compra de ações
  • Auxílio Funeral, incluindo cônjuge, filhos, pais e sogros
  • Plataforma de desenvolvimento

CUIDAMOS TAMBÉM DO SEU BEM-ESTAR:

O Viver Bem é o principal programa de saúde e bem-estar da Prudential, abrangendo as dimensões física, mental e financeira. Nosso objetivo é promover o autocuidado e proporcionar saúde e bem-estar integral aos nossos colaboradores. Os principais serviços oferecidos incluem:

  • Horário flexível
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida
  • Fully e Wellhub: Plataformas para você se cuidar por inteiro, que estimula a atividade física, o cuidado com a saúde mental e financeira.
  • Incentivo financeiro às práticas de atividades físicas
  • Espaço Viver Bem: Ambiente projetado para promover a saúde e o bem-estar;
  • Day off de aniversário
  • Programa de Reconhecimento por Tempo de Casa
  • Viver Bem+: Acesso gratuito a consultas médicas, nutricionista, coach esportivo, acompanhamento a gestantes e atendimento psicológico.
  • Campanha de vacinação nos escritórios
  • Programa de apoio ao colaborador e seus dependentes com aconselhamento financeiro, jurídico e psicológico

title: Lead Project Management Specialist
description:
Overview

Are you a Lead Project Management Specialist who drives customer satisfaction? Are you looking for your next Senior role? Join our team!

At Baker Hughes, we are transforming the future of energy. With operations in over 120 countries, we are developing and deploying industry-leading technologies and services to take energy forward. For more than a century, our inventions have revolutionized energy. Today, we are bringing our expertise to make oil and gas safer, cleaner, and more efficient.

Partner with the best

The Lead Project Management Specialist will be responsible for flawless project execution through effective coordination of activities and resources. You will contribute to innovative technology projects in a complex and interesting technical environment. You will ensure every detail is meticulously planned to deliver successful projects to our customers.

As a Lead Project Management Specialist , you will be responsible for:

  • Creating, monitoring & managing complex project schedules covering engineering, procurement, construction & installation of topside & subsea field equipment during tender & execution of both technology development & customer execution projects.
  • Collaborating with project teams, stakeholders and customers to ensure quality and accuracy of project schedules from tender through to execution.
  • Preparing and performing quantitative schedule risk analysis.
  • Recognizing opportunities and risks and working with stakeholders to identify and execute mitigations that will ensure project delivery, on time and on budget.
  • Preparing and presenting schedule reviews and providing schedule status updates and ensuring that key messages are communicated and understood at all levels of the business.
  • Reviewing planning and project administration specifications and working collaboratively with partners to ensure flawless execution of planning processes.
  • Contributing as a team member or leading small projects. Work goals will typically take 1-3 months to complete and the time horizon for results/impact is typically 6-18 months after the event.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma / GED with experience in Project Management).
  • Have experience in Subsea Oil & Gas Projects.
  • Have experience in Project Planning.
  • Be Experienced Primavera P6 User.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.

Preferred capabilities:

  • Experience in Oracle PRA or OPC Risk tools.
  • Experience in customer facing positions, contract review & negotiation.
  • Capable user of Microsoft Power BI and / or Power Apps.
  • Capable user of Cleopatra, Active Risk Manager & Xaitporter.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working regular hours from a Ventura-RJ based Baker Hughes office.

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  • Tailored financial programs
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits

About Us

With operations in over 120 countries, we provide better solutions for our customers and richer opportunities for our people. As a leading partner to the energy industry, we're committed to achieving net-zero carbon emissions by 2050 and we're always looking for the right people to help us get there. People who are as passionate as we are about making energy safer, cleaner and more efficient.

Join Us

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company with a global reach and exciting services and clients? Come join us and grow with a team of people who will energize and inspire you!

Baker Hughes Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Required Skills & Experience

  • Programming: Strong proficiency in Node.js and Python (C++ a plus)
  • Streaming: Hands-on experience with Kafka, NiFi, Redis Streams, or AWS Kinesis
  • Databases:
    • Time-series: MongoDB, InfluxDB, TimescaleDB, or AWS Timestream

  • AI/Agents: Experience with—or strong interest in—Agentic AI frameworks, multi-agent orchestration, and context-aware data processing

  • Cloud/Infra: AWS, Azure, or GCP with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Software Engineering: Strong grasp of algorithms, distributed systems, microservice design, and API security
  • Problem Solving: Strong debugging skills, creative mindset, and ability to balance speed with scalability

Preferred Skills

  • Machine Learning/NLP integration into multi-modal pipelines
  • CI/CD automation and DevOps practices
  • Knowledge of enterprise integration patterns, event-driven systems, and zero-trust security models
  • Experience with compliance frameworks (NERC CIP, FedRAMP, GDPR, SOX)

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience)
  • 5+ years professional software development with data-intensive or AI-driven systems
  • Proven experience designing, deploying, and scaling modular platforms in production

The Senior Asset Integrity RBI Engineer plays a pivotal role in optimizing inspection strategies within the Oil & Gas facilities or power plant by implementing risk-based inspection methodologies. Inspection Planning and Optimization:

  • Determine appropriate inspection techniques, frequencies, and inspection intervals based on risk assessment results.
  • Optimize inspection schedules to minimize downtime and maximize asset integrity.

Data Management and Documentation:

Reporting to the Technology Director, working in the BWZ Labs Team but also closely with the Web Platform. You will be tasked with the development of internal systems used by dozens of employees, as well as customer facing systems used by thousands of clients.

You don’t have to know all the answers, because you will have the time to research and learn new technologies and solutions, so you can make suggestions and implementations that might fit our product needs to better perform and scale.

Black and White Zebra is a rapidly growing, independent media tech company headquartered in Vancouver, B.C. Canada. Since 2012, our portfolio of influential digital publications has been helping millions of people succeed at work.

Our brands cover project management, product management, people management, customer experience, quality assurance and others, with the goal of connecting people with the knowledge, skills and tools they need to succeed professionally.

Descrição da Vaga

Buscamos um(a) profissional especialista para se juntar à nossa equipe de Risco de Crédito, com atuação dedicada à modelagem de provisionamento. A responsabilidade central desta posição é o desenvolvimento, manutenção e atualização dos modelos para as carteiras de Cartão de Crédito, Empréstimo Pessoal e Empréstimo Consignado , garantindo total aderência às regulamentações IFRS 9 e Resolução 4966 . O candidato ideal terá profundo domínio normativo e habilidade para traduzir os requisitos regulatórios em soluções de modelagem eficazes e adequadas aos desafios de negócio, conduzindo projetos técnicos de alta complexidade.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Desenvolvimento de Modelos de Provisionamento: Participar do ciclo completo de desenvolvimento dos modelos (IFRS 9 e 4966), desde a concepção e delineamento técnico (definição de público, amostras, períodos de análise) até a implementação, documentação e monitoramento de performance.
  • Análise e Tratamento de Dados: Investigar, minerar e manipular grandes volumes de dados para realizar estudos, entender o perfil de risco dos clientes e gerar os insumos necessários para a modelagem.
  • Soluções Analíticas e Conformidade: Propor e desenvolver a solução de modelagem mais adequada para cada problema, com foco principal em garantir a conformidade regulatória, a robustez metodológica e a aplicabilidade para o negócio.
  • Documentação Técnica: Criar e manter documentações detalhadas de todo o processo de desenvolvimento, assegurando a rastreabilidade e o suporte para auditorias internas e externas.
  • Colaboração Estratégica: Interagir de forma colaborativa com as áreas de Negócio, Finanças e Tecnologia para garantir o alinhamento e a correta implementação dos modelos e suas políticas.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação Acadêmica: Superior completo em Estatística, Matemática, Física, Ciências da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Domínio Regulatório: Conhecimento e experiência prática comprovada com as normas de provisionamento IFRS 9 e Resolução 4966.
  • Experiência em Modelagem: Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de modelos de risco de crédito, preferencialmente no setor financeiro e com foco em provisionamento.
  • Habilidades Técnicas:
    • Python: Proficiência no uso de Python para análise de dados e implementação de modelos.
    • SQL: Conhecimento avançado para manipulação de grandes bases de dados (ex: PySpark, Athena, Trino).
    • Versionamento de Código: Experiência com plataformas de hospedagem de código como GitHub ou Bitbucket.
  • Capacidade Analítica: Forte habilidade para identificar problemas, interpretar requisitos regulatórios complexos e propor soluções analíticas adequadas e eficientes.
  • Perfil Comportamental: Colaborativo, com paixão por aprendizado contínuo, orientação a resultados e excelente capacidade de comunicação.

We are hiring a Head of Cloud Alliances to lead business development and partnerships with the global public clouds. As the publisher of Ubuntu, Canonical is already a trusted partner with the leading guest OS and select services for the major hyperscalers. We have a large portfolio of open source software on the cloud marketplace for enterprise customers, and are looking to expand our global cloud partnerships.
Reporting to the VP of Global Alliances, the Global Head of Cloud Alliances will lead teams that bring innovation to the public cloud platforms, joint go-to-market with public cloud sales communities and marketplaces, and our global customer and partner contracts. They will work closely with cloud partners, from engineering to product management and marketing, to deliver open source solutions at scale for their cloud customers.
Our Cloud Alliance team builds trusted relationships with partners at all levels, from joint technical work to executive strategy. Their goal is to increase Canonical market share in the cloud ISV ecosystem, develop cloud channel sales, evangelize the partnership and lead all business interactions. The Global Head of Cloud Alliances will own the strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions with all cloud partners, as well as promotion of our cloud related activities - from campaigns, to strategic opportunities and cloud related events.
Our company is largely distributed, this role can be based anywhere in the Americas or EMEA.
The role entails

  • Taking ownership of Canonical's global cloud partner strategy, leading efforts to forecast, driving bookings, and growing revenue worldwide
  • Building strong, cross-functional relationships across teams to ensure a unified approach to technology and market execution
  • Inspiring and guiding teams to achieve accelerated revenue growth with Cloud partners, continually refining and evolving strategies for success
  • Establishing and nurturing executive-level relationships with key partners, laying the foundation for long-term success and mutual growth
  • Steering our offering from concept to execution, aligning product management and marketing strategies while scaling success through our global sales organization

  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject

  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results

  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Exceptional leadership and presentation skills, capable of energizing teams and stakeholders while delivering compelling data-driven narratives
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • An in-depth understanding of open source technologies, Ubuntu, and the competitive ecosystem, with an eye for identifying opportunities that others might miss.
  • Autonomous, disciplined, and proactive—take ownership, and deliver exceptional results
Nice to have
  • A track record in alliance and indirect sales management, with an ability to build partnerships that drive success
  • Solid experience in the Public Cloud sector, coupled with an understanding of the evolving landscape of technology and innovation.
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)

description:
Overview

Native / Bilingual English is required for this role (read / written / spoken). Please upload your CV Resume in English.

Monthly salary : $5,000 - $6,000

Our partner is a company where data drives insight and architecture drives impact. They provide advanced analytics and real-time data pipelines that power the foodservice supply chain.

Along with our partner, we are seeking a Senior Data Architect to design and evolve scalable, high-performance data systems in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and beyond. This is a strategic technical role responsible for defining architecture and guiding engineering across their entire data platform—from ingestion to analytics.

They work closely with data engineering, software development, product, and business teams to ensure their data architecture supports current and future business needs and build an AI-first engineering process for rapidly building new products. If you’re passionate about designing cloud-native, reliable, and governed data ecosystems that fuel critical insights, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Design and evolve robust, scalable architectures for data lakes, data warehouses, data marts, and operational data stores in cloud environments, especially Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
  • Develop and optimize real-time and batch data pipelines using tools like Apache Airflow, Pentaho, PL / SQL, and Bash scripting.
  • Architect and implement parallel processing workflows to support high-volume ingestion and transformation of structured and unstructured data.
  • Deliver AI-driven data insights for the Food Service Industry and leverage AI tools to increase the rate of delivery for engineering projects.
  • Ensure data quality and governance across the entire pipeline lifecycle, including validation, auditing, and reconciliation.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate functional and non-functional requirements into technical data architecture solutions.
  • Lead and mentor data engineers and cross-functional teams in best practices for data modeling, pipeline design, and cloud infrastructure optimization.
  • Establish data standards, policies, and frameworks to ensure data security, compliance, and operational resilience.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance and scalability across diverse data domains.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven Expertise : 7+ years in data architecture or senior-level data engineering roles, with strong experience in OCI and enterprise-scale data systems. Proven experience leveraging AI to rapidly deliver architectures, data pipelines, applications, and infrastructure.
  • Hands-On Technical Skill : Deep knowledge of PL / SQL, Bash scripting, parallel data processing, AI / ML modeling, and performance optimization in a cloud environment.
  • Cloud-Native Thinking : Strong experience designing scalable systems and cloud-first data platforms (OCI preferred; AWS / Azure also relevant).
  • Pipeline Mastery : Skilled in building and maintaining modern ETL / ELT pipelines, real-time data flows, and orchestration with Apache Airflow or similar.
  • Governance & Validation : Strong grasp of data quality, data validation, metadata management, and governance best practices.
  • Tool Agnostic : Comfortable working with multiple tools, platforms, and formats—CSV, JSON, APIs, Pentaho, Oracle or other relational and NoSQL databases like MySQL, Postgres, MongoDB, Cosmos DB, etc.
  • Business Alignment : Ability to understand the needs of business and analytics teams and deliver high-performing data architectures to meet those needs.
  • Team Leader : Excellent communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills; experience leading cross-functional efforts and mentoring engineers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with supply chain, analytics platforms, and / or foodservice data domains.
  • Background in designing self-service data platforms and data product models.
  • Knowledge of security and compliance frameworks relevant to data platforms.

Benefits

  • The opportunity to contribute to a leading company driving data innovation in the foodservice industry.
  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.
  • Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Web or Flutter front-end experience

We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit globally and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. title: Data Lead
description:
Overview

About YipitData :

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate insights across industries including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare. Our data team identifies, licenses, cleans, and analyzes data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We have been recognized as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces for three years and are backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners. We operate globally with offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore.

About the Role :

We’re seeking a highly motivated, team-oriented Data Lead to drive data strategy and execution across a portfolio of data products. In this role, you’ll report to our Head of Data and split your time between owning challenging analytical work and guiding a team of data analysts to build and deliver top-tier data products. This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives on ownership, collaboration, and delivering measurable value. We encourage applications from those with strong analytical skills who are excited to lead teams, build and optimize data workflows, and partner cross-functionally to shape and execute product strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Own data strategy and execution for a portfolio of high-impact data products for investors, driving product success through a focus on accuracy, client value, and efficiency; partner closely with research and commercial leaders to set and hit ambitious targets
  • Operate as a player-coach, setting a high bar for quality, speed, and innovation while coaching, empowering, and inspiring your team to do their best work
  • Work with large datasets to help answer investor questions about the sectors we cover; learn our proprietary methods to ensure data accuracy and derive key insights
  • Tackle complex data problems, optimize methodologies, test new datasets, and solve data-related problems with innovative solutions
  • Drive standardization, simplification, and improvements to data pipelines and workflows to minimize risk and maximize value
  • Partner cross-functionally with Research and Engineering to uncover and execute opportunities to drive customer value and optimize processes and pipelines

Qualifications

  • You have 5+ years of experience in data analytics, forecasting, or business intelligence, including 1-2 years in a management or lead capacity
  • You have 3+ years of experience with SQL, Python, PySpark, or other programming languages to explore and transform large, complex datasets; proficiency with GitHub and familiarity with Databricks
  • You have strong communication skills and can work and project-manage effectively with stakeholders across technical and non-technical teams
  • You excel at approaching complex problems logically and decisively, and take pride in implementing scalable solutions
  • You have strong ownership and an entrepreneurial mentality and are enthusiastic about collaborating to make a big impact
  • Preferred: You’ve worked in or alongside capital markets, investment research, or financial services

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits; New York-based team
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Growth at YipitData is based on impact, not tenure; we promote learning, self-improvement, and mastery in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust

description:
3 months ago Be among the first 25 applicants

We have opened several senior/staff Security Operations Engineer (SOC) positions, creating a new team reporting to the CISO. We are looking for a range of experience in these positions - at the high end we are looking for deep experience defending highly contested critical assets and high-value cyber targets against advanced persistent threats and state-level actors. We have more junior roles for exceptional individuals with a proven personal interest an engagement in cyber attack and defence, and outstanding academic and career performance even if experience is limited.
Our goal is to build an entirely new level of assurance and observable rigour into the open source supply chain. We have our own estate to monitor, but more broadly our goal is to raise the robustness of the entire global Ubuntu estate through the work of this team.
The Security Operations (SecOps) team is responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.
The SecOps team's mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.
What you will do in this role:

  • Implement and evolve Canonical's Security Operation Center
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations
  • Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs
  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change
What we are looking for
  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Previous professional experience working or leading a Security Operation Center
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Expertise in threat modelling and risk management frameworks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF and ISO27001
Optional things we value
  • Experience in a security operations team or a security operations centre (SOC)
  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability
  • Experience with state-actor and other advanced persistent threats
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Lateral stands for technology excellence. We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses.
